notFound.title: 404 - Page Not Found
notFound.message: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.

unauthorized.title: 401 - Unauthorized
unauthorized.message: You don't have permission to access this resource.

forbidden.title: 403 - Forbidden
forbidden.message: You don't have the required permissions to access this page.

serverError.title: 500 - Server Error
serverError.message: Something went wrong on our end. Please try again later.

assetAccess.readDenied: You don't have access to this asset. Viewing it needs read/write access to Assets, or access to a data product it belongs to.
assetAccess.writeDenied: Changing the notes, links, documents and costs of an asset needs read/write access to Assets.

internalError: An unexpected error occurred. The details are in the server log (error id {{errorId}}).
userTokenRequired: This request needs your Databricks access token, and none was received. Reload the page; if this persists, ask an administrator to enable user authorization for the app.

subscription.productNotSubscribable: Cannot subscribe to '{{productName}}': its status is '{{status}}'. Only active products accept new subscriptions.
